claim.value: The fraction of exports exceeding one hour should be evaluated alongside the question of median stability.
claim.scope: Distinct tail and median aspects of the proposed outcome assessment.

provenance.rationale: P021 explicitly pairs the one-hour exceedance fraction with assessment of median stability.

signal_basis.value: The proposed measurements track the fraction exceeding one hour and time-to-completion estimates that include unfinished exports, alongside assessment of median stability.
signal_basis.scope: Proposed outcome measurements, not results already obtained.

provenance.rationale: P021 supplies the measurements and treatment of unfinished exports; P025 establishes their proposed status.
No unresolved empirical relation is needed to warrant this outcome-assessment claim.

rationale: Median stability does not determine the fraction of exports exceeding one hour. Assessing both therefore captures distinct aspects of the outcome distribution and directly licenses this limited measurement recommendation.
uncertainty: The claim establishes neither an observed tail change nor an effect of the concurrency intervention.
